literal_meaning: বয়সের কোনো গাছ বা পাথর নেই (age has no tree or stone)
figurative_meaning_en: Extremely old, with an age that cannot be counted or measured
example_sentences_in_bangla: গ্রামের সেই বুড়ো মানুষটির বয়সের গাছ পাথর নাই, কেউ তার আসল বয়স জানে না।
এই গাছটির বয়সের গাছ পাথর নাই, এটি শতাব্দী প্রাচীন।
example_sentences_in_english: That old man in the village is so ancient; his age has no tree or stone to mark it.
This tree is incredibly old; its age has no tree or stone to count by.
note: This idiom draws from rural imagery where trees and stones symbolize enduring markers of time, emphasizing immeasurable longevity in Bengali oral tradition.
